description: Permanently deletes one of the signed-in person's songs (all its box versions), or a song you saved without an account (pass its claim_token). This cannot be undone: tell the person which song will be deleted, ask them to confirm, then call again with confirmed: true.

claim_token.description: Only for songs saved without an account.

confirmed.description: true only after the person confirmed the deletion.

name: delete_song
title: Delete a song
